Puri Law is a Jodhpur-based legal practice led by Rakesh Kumar Puri, an advocate and retired Additional Superintendent of Police with 35 years of police service and 11 years of criminal law practice. THE EXPERIENCE BEHIND THE PRACTICE

Rakesh Kumar Puri
Advocate & Founder

Retired Additional Superintendent of Police · Jodhpur, Rajasthan

A practice shaped by 35 years of police service and 11 years of criminal law practice.

His policing career included service as Superintendent of Police, JDVVNL, and Superintendent of Police, Anti-Terrorism Squad (ATS), Jodhpur, alongside extensive field postings as Station House Officer (SHO) and Circle Officer across various districts of Rajasthan. These responsibilities provided direct exposure to investigative processes, evidentiary considerations, and procedural complexities that arise in criminal matters.

As an advocate practising before the Rajasthan High Court and District & Sessions Courts, he brings this practical background to criminal defence, trial advocacy, investigation-related legal advice, bail proceedings, quashing petitions, and writ litigation. The practice also provides informed legal support for fellow advocates, businesses, and organisations dealing with complex criminal or investigation-related issues.

OUR PROCESS

How We Work with Clients & Counsel

A transparent, disciplined approach from initial enquiry to final judgment.

01

Initial Contact & Conflict Check

Submission of enquiry via phone, WhatsApp, or website form. Preliminary screening for conflict of interest and jurisdictional maintainability.

02

Scope & Rates Consultation

Comprehensive review of available documents. Direct consultation and transparent quotation of legal consultation rates based on complexity.

03

Case Theory & Preparation

Deep scrutiny of charge sheets, forensic reports, and witness statements to establish a fact-specific case theory and draft pleadings.

04

Courtroom Advocacy & Updates

Rigorous trial and appellate advocacy before Sessions Courts and Rajasthan High Court, accompanied by regular client briefings.

FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS

Common Client & Consultation Enquiries

Key information regarding consultation fees, representation, and Bar Council policies.

How are legal consultation rates determined?

In accordance with Bar Council of India standards, consultation rates are not publicly advertised. Fees depend strictly on the complexity of the matter, volume of investigation records, court jurisdiction, and required time. You can ask for consultation rates directly by contacting chambers.

How does the firm assist fellow advocates?

R.K. Puri Law offers specialized litigation and investigation support to advocates and law firms. We assist with case theory formulation, charge-sheet analysis, forensic cross-examination strategies, and advisory on police procedural lapses.

What courts and jurisdictions does the firm practice in?

Our advocates represent clients before the High Court of Judicature for Rajasthan (Jodhpur & Jaipur), District & Sessions Courts, Magistrate Courts, and Special Courts (NDPS, POCSO, CBI, Anti-Corruption / PC Act, SC/ST Act) across Rajasthan.

What is the firm’s non-solicitation policy?

Under Rule 36 of the Bar Council of India Rules, this website is purely informational and does not solicit clients or advertise services. Any engagement is confirmed only after formal acceptance and conflict-of-interest checks.

Bar Council of India Compliance & Non-Solicitation Policy

As per the rules of the Bar Council of India (Rule 36, Section IV, Chapter II, Part VI of the Bar Council of India Rules), advocates are prohibited from soliciting work or advertising. By visiting this website, you acknowledge that you are seeking information regarding R.K. Puri Law of your own accord and that no advocate-client relationship is created prior to formal engagement. Review our complete Non-Solicitation Policy and Disclaimer.
